description: Create the in-app form a Snapchat lead ad opens. Snapchat's rules are refused BY NAME, never repaired: FIRST_NAME and LAST_NAME are required, plus at least one of EMAIL or PHONE_NUMBER; ADDRESS and POSTAL_CODE cannot both be on one form; title max 25 characters, description max 180, legal title 35 / description 80, at most 2 consent checkboxes, only one question may use preferred options, and an end page (endPage) is required. A form spends nothing; it is read back from Snapchat. Snapchat has NO endpoint that lists leads afterwards — to receive them, turn on delivery with manage_snapchat_ads_lead_webhook(action:'subscribe'). Free.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

bannerMediaId.description: an IMAGE media id already on the ad account; 75:23, 750x230 to 1875x575, 5MB

description.description: max 180 characters, shown above the questions

endPage.description: REQUIRED by Snapchat (E25022): the screen shown after someone submits

callToAction.description: default VIEW_WEBSITE — the end page has its own list, not the creative one

fields.description: the questions, in order: standard types as strings (FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE_NUMBER, ADDRESS, POSTAL_CODE, BIRTHDAY_DATE, JOB_TITLE, COMPANY_NAME) and custom questions as {question, kind, options}

legal.description: legal disclosure: title max 35, description max 80, up to 2 consent checkboxes

consents.description: up to 2 consent checkboxes: plain text, or {text, required}

description.description: legal disclosure body text, max 80 characters

title.description: legal disclosure heading shown on the form, max 35 characters

name.description: the form name in Ads Manager

title.description: max 25 characters, shown at the top of the form

name: create_snapchat_ads_lead_form
title: Create a Snapchat lead form
